parrafo.es: Sierra Auto Service es un taller de mecánica general en Little Havana, atendido por su dueño, que es uno de los mecánicos, y su esposa en la oficina. Sin cita previa: llegas, te revisan el carro y te dan un precio claro antes de empezar.
parrafo.en: Sierra Auto Service is a general mechanic shop in Little Havana, run by the owner, who is one of the mechanics, with his wife working the office. No appointment needed: you drive up, they take a look, and you get a straight price before any work starts.

parrafo_1.es: Sierra Auto Service lleva años en el mismo local de SW 7th Street, en Little Havana. Es un negocio familiar: el dueño es uno de los mecánicos y su esposa lleva la oficina. No hay centralita ni vendedor en medio, hablas directo con quien va a tocar tu carro.
parrafo_1.en: Sierra Auto Service has been at the same spot on SW 7th Street in Little Havana for years. It is a family business: the owner is one of the mechanics, and his wife runs the office. There is no call center and no salesperson in between, you talk directly to the person who is going to work on your car.

parrafo_2.es: Los clientes repiten lo mismo en sus reseñas: precios razonables, nada de inflar el problema, y ayuda incluso en emergencias sin cita, como un radiador que explotó antes de una reunión o frenos dañados de un carro que venía de fuera del estado.
parrafo_2.en: Customers keep saying the same thing in their reviews: reasonable prices, nothing padded, and help even with no-appointment emergencies, like a radiator that blew right before a meeting or damaged brakes on a car that came in from out of state.

texto.es: No necesitas cita. Llama al (305) 476-9223 o llega directo a la bahía abierta en SW 7th Street y cuéntale al dueño qué le pasa a tu carro.
texto.en: No appointment needed. Call (305) 476-9223 or just pull up to the open bay on SW 7th Street and tell the owner what is going on with your car.

texto.es: El mismo dueño revisa el carro y te dice qué tiene de verdad, sin adivinar ni inflar el problema para cobrar más.
texto.en: The owner looks at the car himself and tells you what is actually wrong, no guessing games and no padding the problem to charge more.

texto.es: Frenos, radiador, calipers o lo que haga falta se trabaja ahí mismo, en el taller de toda la vida.
texto.en: Brakes, radiator, calipers or whatever the job calls for gets worked on right there, in the same shop that has been on this block for years.

texto.es: Te vas con un precio razonable y sin sorpresas, lo mismo que los clientes repiten una y otra vez en sus reseñas.
texto.en: You leave with a reasonable price and no surprises, the same thing customers keep mentioning in their reviews.

nota.es: Cada reparación se revisa primero y se cotiza según el problema real de tu carro. Llama al (305) 476-9223 y el dueño te da un precio claro.
nota.en: Every repair gets looked at first and quoted for what your car actually needs. Call (305) 476-9223 and the owner will give you a straight price.

texto.es: Frenos, calipers, correas, diagnóstico de motor y las reparaciones del día a día, hechas por el mismo dueño del taller.
texto.en: Brakes, calipers, belts, engine diagnostics and the everyday repairs that keep your car running, done by the shop's own owner.

texto.es: Un cliente llegó de fuera del estado con calipers y frenos dañados; lo atendieron sin cita y a un precio razonable.
texto.en: One customer drove in from out of state with messed-up calipers and brakes; he was helped with no appointment and at a reasonable price.

texto.es: Un radiador que explotó antes de una reunión se resolvió con presupuesto a la mañana siguiente y dos horas de reparación.
texto.en: A blown radiator right before a meeting got a quote the next morning and a two-hour turnaround on the repair.

texto.es: Un carro remolcado por un problema de termostato se atendió al momento, con un precio honesto frente a lo que otro taller quería cobrar.
texto.en: A truck towed in for a thermostat problem was taken in right away, with an honest price next to what another shop was trying to charge.

pie.es: ¿Tu carro hace un ruido raro o no arranca? Llama igual, mucho se resuelve con solo verlo.
pie.en: Car making a weird noise or won't start? Call anyway, a lot gets sorted out just by taking a look at it.

items.quote: Family owned business that has been at the same location for years. The owner is one of the mechanics and his wife works the office. Don't try to bounce around the various mechanic shops in the same building to compare prices because most are going to be the same.

Un hombre muy amable, professional y honesto. I left my car at his shop in the night, then I couldn't get an estimate, and he charged me little money, without taking advantage for that circumstance. And the job was perfect.

Had an emergency with a blown radiator just before a meeting. A quick Google search led me to these guys who were close by and had some good reviews. I dropped the car and first thing the next morning I had a quote and a two hour turnaround time. They were fast, friendly and had honest prices.

texto.es: No hace falta cita, solo llega. El dueño revisa el carro y te da un precio claro.
texto.en: No appointment needed, just drive up. The owner takes a look and gives you a straight price.

texto.es: Lunes a viernes 8 AM a 7 PM, sábados 8 AM a 5 PM. Cerrado los domingos.
texto.en: Monday to Friday 8 AM to 7 PM, Saturday 8 AM to 5 PM. Closed Sundays.

notas_variante_adaptada.sin_website_propio: Sin dominio propio ni redes sociales publicas encontradas (busqueda web verificada); el unico canal publico es la ficha de Google Maps y el telefono.
notas_variante_adaptada.sin_precios_publicados: No hay lista de precios publicada. Se muestran los servicios reales mencionados en las resenas (frenos, calipers, radiadores) sin precio fijo, con nota de 'se cotiza, llama y te decimos'.
notas_variante_adaptada.sin_email_publico: No se encontro email publico tras busqueda en Birdeye, directorios y web; campo email del registro queda null.
notas_variante_adaptada.resenas: 5 resenas verbatim extraidas de Google Maps (reviewSamples en data.json); se usaron 3 en social_proof.modo:testimonios, verbatim, sin editar el contenido.
notas_variante_adaptada.fotos: Las fotos de 'area' de Google Maps mezclaban negocios vecinos del mismo edificio multi-tenant (Lazaro Auto Service, Tony's Vehicle Solutions, Versailles Multiservicios, una gasolinera Valero) que NO son Sierra Auto Service: se descartaron. Se confirmaron 5 fotos reales y propias de Sierra Auto Service via el panel de fotos de su ficha (letrero, fachada, bahia abierta, retrato del mecanico/dueno). El retrato del dueno se uso SOLO como avatar en Nosotros, nunca como tile de galeria, por regla de curaduria.
